note: Query -> the endpoint that should answer it. `maxRank` is the worst position the expected endpoint may occupy in the top 8; `miss` records a query the lexical scorer is known not to serve, with the reason. Tighten these when the ranker improves; never loosen one without saying why.

cases.q: list all folders in a project

cases.why: regressed 2 -> 3 when the phrase bonus landed: 'new folder' is not a phrase in any haystack, while the competing mkdir endpoint gains from 'create'. Accepted — the phrase bonus is a net gain across the set.

cases.q: show me the test runs for a project
upload an attachment to a test case
who has access to this project
what changed recently, who edited what
get full detail of one test case including steps

cases.why: the entity name listEntities returns, verbatim — the documented flow must not be the losing one
same, plural: underscore has to tokenize like a space

cases.q: record a pass or fail for a test case in a run
cases.why: reached only through the status enum [pass, fail, bug, retest, block, note] on the parameter — the words appear nowhere in the prose
same: the caller's word is a parameter VALUE, not a noun in the description

cases.q: make a new bucket for my tests
cases.miss: 'bucket' is nobody's word for a folder; no lexical scorer reaches this

cases.q: get rid of a test plan
cases.miss: 'get' trips the READ verb list, so the destructive endpoint takes the mode penalty. Harmless: destructive endpoints are refused before binding anyway.
